# Chapter 1: The Glass Horizon

The bells of the [[Sanctuaire des Étoiles]] chimed across the frozen valley.

Renée adjusted her cloak as the wind swept snow through the archway. The crystal hummed at 440 Hz—a pure, unyielding pitch.

"The resonance is shifting," she whispered, recording $E = h \cdot \nu$ upon the parchment.
Even a cost of $50 was beyond her means, but the secret was priceless.
